gloss: to be struck by; to be afflicted with (disaster, misfortune, illness)

definitions.gloss: to be struck by; to be afflicted with (a disaster, misfortune, illness, or unwelcome event)
definitions.explanation: The passive form of {見舞|みま}う ("to inquire after, to visit a sick person; to befall"). In its most common modern use, {見舞|みま}われる means to suffer or be hit by something unpleasant — typhoons, earthquakes, accidents, illness, financial troubles. Almost always used with に marking the misfortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われた。
examples.english: We were hit by a typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{洪水|こうずい}→洪水：05065_kouzui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われた。
examples.english: The town was struck by flooding from heavy rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帰国|きこく}→帰国：03025_kikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧、⟦{思|おも}わぬ→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われた。
examples.english: On my way home, I ran into unexpected trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{津波|つなみ}→津波：05064_tsunami⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われ、⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Struck by the dual disasters of an earthquake and tsunami, the recovery took a long time.

notes:
{見舞|みま}われる is the passive form of ⟦{見舞|みま}う→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧ and is by far the more common form in everyday and journalistic Japanese when describing being hit by misfortune. The pattern is essentially fixed: [victim/place]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[misfortune]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる.

GRAMMATICAL PATTERN:
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: [subject] is struck by [misfortune]
  - ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われた: "The town was struck by a typhoon."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: to be hit by a typhoon
- ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: to be struck by an earthquake
- ⟦{病|やまい}→病：13610_yamai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: to fall ill (literary)
- ⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: to be visited by misfortune
- ⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: to run into trouble
- ⟦{不景気|ふけいき}→不景気：18557_fukeiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: to be hit by an economic downturn
- ⟦{寒波|かんぱ}→寒波：12354_kanpa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: to be hit by a cold snap

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to encounter, to meet with (a misfortune); more colloquial. ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧ ("to be in an accident")
- ⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to be attacked, to be assailed; stronger, often used for both attacks and sudden physical sensations (⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧ "to be overcome with anxiety")
- ⟦{被|こうむ}る→被る：18070_koumuru⟧: to suffer (formal/literary; takes the misfortune as direct object: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{被|こうむ}る→被る：18070_koumuru⟧)

USAGE:
- ⟦{見舞|みま}う→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧ itself originally meant "to inquire after, to visit (a sick person)," and that older sense survives in ⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧ ("a sympathy visit / get-well gift"). The modern "to befall" sense was extended from there: misfortune "visits" the victim.
- The active form ⟦{見舞|みま}う→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧ in the "to befall" sense (e.g., ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見舞|みま}った→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧) is heard mainly in literary or news writing; the passive {見舞|みま}われる is far more common in speech.
- Almost always negative in connotation. To say someone was "visited" by a positive event, use ⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧ or ⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧ instead.
